Subject: RFI: ISO/FedRAMP readiness — request and proposed windows

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Acme is lining up vendor evidence for a FedRAMP readiness assessment and an ISO 27001 gap analysis next quarter. We need a short RFI to understand scope and timing so we can prioritize the audit window on our side.

Primary asks:
- Confirm which Redwood environments are in-scope for FedRAMP (prod only, or prod + staging / enclave?).
- High-level timeline for controls evidence (logs, encryption docs, attestation owners) between Jan 5–Mar 1.
- SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ point of contact for each evidence area.
- Any expected interruptions for snapshot extraction (we need to book auditors).

Can you send a short cadence (owners + dates) and a first-pass RFI by EOD Monday PST? We’ll add the intake to our procurement calendar once we have dates.

Best,

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear asks. I’ll own the coordination and propose a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can lock dates quickly. High-level answers below and an attachment with an initial scope matrix is included.

Quick answers:
- In-scope: production clusters (us-west) are in-scope for FedRAMP readiness. Staging is treated as supporting but not within the certification boundary unless we confirm data residency requirements.
- Timeline: draft MAP attached — proposed evidence handoff windows: Jan 6–Jan 20 (logging + access controls), Jan 21–Feb 10 (encryption & key mgmt artifacts), Feb 11–Feb 28 (operational procedures + personnel attestations).
- POCs: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ coordinator: me (hannah.schmitt@redwood.com). Technical controls: marissa.cole@redwood.com. Crypto & KMS: karthik.iyer@redwood.com.
- Snapshot interruptions: we aim for non-disruptive snapshot extraction; we’ll provide blackout windows in the MAP. Any forced maintenance will be scheduled outside your audit windows.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the proposed windows by Monday EOD PST.
2) If Acme requires staging in the boundary, flag that now — it adds ~2 weeks to the timeline due to environment hardening.
3) We’ll host a 30-min intake call Friday to walk through the MAP and attachments.

Attachment: ISO_scope_matrix_v1.xlsx (scope rows + suggested evidence owners).

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Compliance Programs
